phase: Phase 4 - Hybrid Recommendation Engine & Serving API

full_regression.notes: Full regression suite executes in under 200 seconds with zero regressions.

als_kg_integration.notes: ALS delivery service and KG recommend service integrate cleanly into HybridRecommenderService.

candidate_union.notes: Candidates from both sources are deduplicated with honest source tagging (als, kg, both).

fusion_correctness.notes: RRF (k=60) and Weighted Fusion verified against mathematical oracles.

seen_filtering.notes: Seen filtering enforced at candidate generation and post-fusion defense-in-depth.

explainability.notes: Items explain their origin faithfully with raw KG path evidence intact.

cache_correctness.notes: Cache key accounts for user, strategy, top_n, filter_seen, budgets, weights, and cross-score modes.

api_correctness.notes: API endpoints strictly validated with HTTP 422 for bad inputs and 403 for unauthorized cache clear.

validation_integrity.notes: KG achieves highest accuracy (NDCG@10 = 0.0497); Hybrid achieves highest coverage and diversity.

performance_evidence.notes: Disproved misconception that KG traversal takes 0.017 ms; profiled all 9 pipeline stages.

reproducibility.notes: Repeated runs yield identical recommendation sets and score ordering.

production_recommendations: Retain RRF as the default fusion algorithm due to scale-invariance and lower computational overhead.
Precompute or asynchronously warm KG candidate lists to keep P95 serving latency below 50 ms.
In multi-worker production deployments, attach an external Redis service for cross-worker cache sharing.
